claims.text: Many reviewers say the deodorant effectively controls odor for their kids, especially active boys.
Several reviewers praise it as a safe, mild, kid-friendly option, though a few note sensitive skin can be irritated at first.
Some reviewers report the product stopped working after a few months or didn't work well enough, leading them to switch.
A few reviewers complain about strong smell or alcohol content causing stinging, and one notes it goes on wet.
Some reviewers mention their child dislikes the scent even though the parent likes it.
